instructions: Read the complete policy, then handle all independent producer checkpoints and questions. Read each existing ledger before work. Runs are already minted by the real CLI. Reconcile ledger observations and emit the required ledger mutation events. Handle event observations in supplied order, emitting or explicitly skipping each. Include all supplied gate/rework metadata as requested by this workload. Controlled transcripts advance between observations; their counts are measured by the CLI, never supplied by you. The harness runs real runcheck, event validation/read and a completed-ledger summary consumer after finish. No tracker, review, build, run-open/close, publication or lifecycle operations are requested. Finish after every case and question.

tools.name: read_policy
tools.description: Read the unchanged policy in bounded chunks. Start at offset 0, then use each returned next_offset until it is null. Complete policy delivery is required before workflow operations. No scratch file is needed.

tools.name: read_ledger
tools.description: Read the existing command-created ledger for an independent case.

tools.name: write_ledger
tools.description: Merge a producer-field patch into the actual ledger. Command-owned and unknown fields are refused and recorded as errors.

tools.name: append_event
tools.description: Execute the real pinned events append CLI with the supplied JSON payload on stdin. Every invocation includes --run and --root for this case; token-tagged invocations also include --tokens and --session-id. Flag order is free; no other flags. For ledger edits use transition_id ledger-edit; for phase observations use their supplied id.

tools.name: skip_transition
tools.description: Record an observation that does not warrant an event, with a brief reason.

tools.name: answer_rule
tools.description: Record the requested structured answer to one independent policy question.

tools.name: finish
tools.description: Finish after all cases and questions. The harness then runs real runcheck, event validation/read and the completed-ledger summary consumer.

cases.task: Reconcile the supplied observations into the existing run ledger through the controlled augmentation port. Preserve command-owned state. Record the required ledger event after the direct edit. Earlier tracker changes, review, landing and filing are completed preconditions, not tasks to repeat. Persist the supplied issue_detail under outcome_details for its named issues. Additional source-grounded detail for admitted build issues is optional; do not invent facts. outcome_details keys may name only supplied admitted_build_ids.
